The Brain & Performance Centre

The Journey to Possibility

A brand film following one child's route through the centre's comprehensive assessment and treatment programme — told through her consultant pediatrician's voice, from first consultation to milestones of everyday independence.

≈ 100 sec

Assessment Room

4 shots
